title: Frame, Epoch, and Root Authority Registry
negative_results: An unregistered body/root/frame/epoch/orientation/ephemeris is refused (AuthorityError); no hidden default.
A version-less lookup is refused when more than one version is registered; legacy versions are preserved side by side.
A FRAME/EPOCH certificate payload missing a schema-required field (frame_epoch.schema.json) is refused.
A tampered certificate fails its hash check on registration and on lookup.

claims.statement: The registry names body/root/frame/epoch/time-scale/orientation/ephemeris authorities by typed id + version + hash so a decode records exactly which ones it used (contract invariant 2).
Certificate hashes are deterministic and stable across builds; tampering is detected.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
